data.narrative:
Nimble Robotics, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company led by founder Simon Kalouche, has raised $221M to date against a current post-money valuation of $1.0B. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer set of 6 private companies at same or adjacent stages, with a sample including Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), and Hadrian ($1.6B, Series D), alongside 1 public comparable and 8 additional private references in the robotics sector.

Two methods were applied to triangulate fair value. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to Series D/late-stage transitions, yielding $1.7B from the $1.0B base. Peer-median analysis across the 6-company comp set produced an identical implied valuation of $1.7B, with peers ranging from $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods showed convergence at the $1.7B midpoint, supporting consistency of the analysis.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.4B (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $1.7B. This suggests the current $1.0B post-money valuation reflects a modest discount to peer medians at this stage. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency trends post-Series C, execution against subsequent fundraising milestones, and relative competitive positioning within the robotics subsector.
